headline: Chiefs defense stops the Colts
what_happened: The Colts quarterback D.Jones tried to run for extra yards, but J.Hicks and the Chiefs defense stopped him after a short 5-yard gain.
who: D.Jones carried the ball while J.Hicks made the tackle for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is great news for our Chiefs! Because it is now 4th down, the Colts are much less likely to score, which helps secure our lead.
